name: Weather bracket fade
description: Screen for a forecast-vs-price taker strategy on daily-high weather brackets (NWP forecasts, longshot bias, intraday lock-in/nowcast). No taker edge found; parked until recorded books allow a maker version.
hypothesis: Retail overpays for cheap brackets vs forecast-implied probability; a taker on the other side earns it. Refuted in screening: market mid beats free NWP forecasts, and the longshot bias (~1.5c) is smaller than spread + fee.
next: Maker version (post-only quotes on cheap brackets) once recorded weather books exist (recording since 2026-10-13); no taker pipeline run was justified.
